meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Zhu Xiao-Mei, Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit, Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra, Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
